  Details:
  Raw machine execution for the Sophia session context-compaction rollout (2026-09-05), per dao/DAO_CLIENT_AI_AGENT_CONTRIBUTIONS.md split convention.
  
  **What changed:** truesight_autopilot session history now auto-compacts before it stalls — PR0 added app/context_compaction.py (token counting, turn-boundary detection, Done-this-turn extraction, backup helper); PR1 added the governor-only compact_session_manual tool; PR2 wired compaction into the live turn path (20K token threshold, keep-last-6-turns verbatim, env kill-switch CONTEXT_COMPACTION_AUTO); PR3 moved the check inside both round loops (per-round re-check). agentic_ai_context plan SOPHIA_CONTEXT_COMPACTION_PLAN.md closed out as COMPLETE.
  
  **Tool execution:** ~80 ops across the rollout — ssh diagnostics and journal inspection (~40 runs), compileall/ruff/pytest gate runs (incl. multiple full-suite runs ~5 min each), git push + PR open/merge machinery (#401/#402/#403/#915), CI polling on #403, deploy_autopilot check, live-fold verification (process environ, pre-compact backups, session JSON shape), plan-file edits + merge (#915). PR3 (#404) itself authored/deployed by Envoy; Sophia independently verified it live.
  
  Estimate: ~90 minutes raw machine time (machine tool/script wall-clock; governor may adjust). TDG Issued: 0.
  
  ## Pull requests
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/401 (PR0 — compaction library + tests)

  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/403 (PR2 — automatic wiring + kill-switch)
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/404 (PR3 — per-round re-check, by Envoy)
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/915 (plan close-out)
